notes: I read the verifier: it checks the three contaminated files byte-match reference copies AND that git diff against commit d6987af shows no other file changed. So this is a working-tree edit, NOT a history rewrite - I deliberately ranked the many 'expunge secret.key from remote history' tasks (RTS/TW have a big cluster of them) below the plain find-and-redact tasks, even though they score higher lexically. TMax is by far the strongest pool here: it has a whole family of AKIA-redaction tasks and I could have filled 20 slots. SWE-Rebench is weak - no secret-scanning task exists there, so I fell back to credential-handling libraries (botocore creds, cryptography key loading, keyring/token plumbing) and git-tooling internals; ranks 4-10 there are honest filler at overall 2. RTS's secret.key/rclone-credential-recovery families have many near-duplicates; I picked distinct variants but the merge step should dedupe across them.
